We joined this tour expecting a true immersion into the world of Bollywood.
The studio is indeed a real working studio used for filming, but the experience offered does not quite match what one might imagine from a “Bollywood tour.”

You get to see sets and filming areas, but it is not access to major film productions or the behind-the-scenes world of iconic Bollywood movies. The visit feels more like a tourist-oriented presentation than an authentic insight into the Indian film industry.

It is not a bad visit in itself, but it may create expectations that are not fully aligned with reality. In my view, it is not truly a Bollywood experience in the way it is advertised.

featured_reviews.name: Mesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
HIGHLIGHT - If you have been to Hyderabad's version, you will likely find this visit a complete letdown.

My recent visit to Mumbai Film City was far from what I had hoped. To start, the nearest metro station is Aarey, it is about 4 km away. From there, take an auto (no more than ₹150) straight to the official ticket counter. Be cautious, several individuals may try to sell you tickets along the way at inflated prices. Avoid them, as they are scammers.

After a long wait, we were taken inside the premises by an AC bus. Unfortunately, the experience was underwhelming from the beginning. Compared to Hyderabad's Film City, this one feels small, restricted, and poorly organized. Most of what you see are large tin sheets covering the sets, there is no access to the actual sets themselves. It felt like being shown billboards of what you could see, but never actually do.

The tour ends at Bollywood Park, which hosts a few staged performances. This was the only mildly enjoyable part. The on site restaurant is strictly vegetarian, which may not appeal to everyone, and the food was overpriced for its quality.

description: Chandivali “Studio,” As It Is Known, Began Its Journey In 1940 When Chandrarao Kadam Purchased A Large Parcel Of Land At Chandivali, Near Powai Lake In Mumbai, India. His Idea Was To Create Multiple And Diverse Filming Locations In One Place, Use Them For Shooting His Own Films But Also Make These Locations Available To Other Film Producers. This Innovative Concept Was Unprecedented In The Indian Movie Industry And Became A Template That Many Others Would Follow. It Took Mr. Kadam Nearly Four Years To Clear And Level The Existing Forestland And A Lifetime To Create And Develop The Parcel’s Various Themed Areas. Chandivali Outdoor Location Opened For Business In 1944.

featured_reviews.name: siddharth chowdhury
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been attending Shashi Singh Dance Academy for over a year now, and I can say with complete honesty that it’s been one of the most rewarding decisions I’ve made.

What truly sets this academy apart is the way they teach. There’s a strong emphasis on fundamentals, and the instructors take the time to break down every step so that even someone with no prior experience can follow along. The pace is thoughtful and structured, you’re never rushed, and yet you can clearly see your progress over time. Everyone gets equal attention, and no one is made to feel out of place.

A special mention to Rohan and Khushi, their dedication and passion are hard to miss. They bring consistency, patience, and a lot of positive energy to every session. No matter how many times you need to revisit a step, they’re always willing to guide you through it without hesitation.

I joined with quite a bit of hesitation due to past experiences elsewhere, but this academy completely changed my outlook. I’ve seen people, including myself, start from zero and gradually build both skill and confidence. It genuinely reinforces the belief that anyone can learn to dance with the right guidance.

The environment here is another highlight, it’s warm, collaborative, and encouraging. People uplift each other, and there’s a shared sense of growth. Weekend classes have become something I genuinely look forward to, and I almost always leave with a smile.

It may not be as widely talked about as some others, but it absolutely deserves recognition. If you’re looking for a place that focuses on real learning, consistency, and a supportive atmosphere, this academy is definitely worth considering.
